title: The Effect of Synthesis Methods on the Structure and Catalytic Performance of Cu/Al2O3 Catalysts for CO2 Hydrogenation to Methanol

records.preparation: Impregnation method; Al2O3 calcined at 800 ℃ for 5 h, impregnated with Cu(NO3)2·3H2O, calcined at 500 ℃ for 2 h; before performance test reduced 2 h in H2 atmosphere.

h2_co2_ratio.location: SI Catalyst activity evaluation; derived from CO2:H2 = 1:3

co2_conversion.location: SI Figure S9a

methanol_sty.location: SI Figure S9d

extraction_notes: Experimental catalyst-performance data in the SI are reported mainly as plots in SI Figure S9, with a repeated CP/HT comparison in SI Figure S12. Values from these plots were read approximately against labelled axes and marked with qualifier '~'. SI Figure S10 reports calculated TOF and Arrhenius plots but the available schema has no TOF/activation-energy fields; those were not extracted as separate records. SI Table S5 is a literature-comparison table and was not used as a primary source, except noted where its 'This work' STY appears to corroborate the plotted 310 ℃ HT value. Characterisation tables/figures and DRIFTS assignments were excluded.
